**Drafted 4.2.0 into `CHANGELOG.md`.** Out of 380 commits, 15 matter to users.

Two calls I made that you may want to flip:

1. Two "refactor" commits are really breaking. The v1 export route was deleted, and error types stopped being re-exported.
2. The 401 change was tagged a fix. I put it under Breaking.

Ten speed-up commits have no home in your three headings.
